C1302.title: Trivy Security Scanner GitHub Actions Compromised, 75 Tags Hijacked
C1302.summary: An attacker force-pushed 75 tags via GitHub Actions, exposing the Trivy project's CI/CD secrets. The leaked tokens could be exploited to steal data and establish persistent access in developer systems, constituting a typical supply chain attack.
